entities.name: Hollowhenge
entities.description: The Lost Capital, a ruin where Kessig's county seat Avabruck once stood.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Region of Innistrad whose county seat was Avabruck.

entities.name: Mondronen
entities.description: Howlpack of werewolves that slaughtered Avabruck's people and besieged the Temple.

entities.name: Temple of Saint Raban
entities.description: Central cathedral of Avabruck whose wards failed.

entities.name: Avacynian magic
entities.description: Protective magic whose waning let the wards fail.

events.summary: As Avacynian magic wanes, the wards around the Temple of Saint Raban fail and werewolves discover the breach.
events.quote: the wards around Avabruck's central cathedral, the Temple of Saint Raban, failed

events.summary: The Mondronen howlpack rips through the town, slaughters residents and besieges the Temple.
events.quote: The howlpack known as Mondronen ripped through the town

events.summary: A blood ritual by the Mondronen levels the city, killing hundreds.
events.quote: A mystical, concussive force leveled the city from the center out

events.summary: The city is abandoned and haunted by ghosts and scavengers.
events.quote: As time went on, the city was abandoned, even by the howlpack.

relations.note: It stands where Kessig's county seat once stood.
relations.quote: standing where Kessig 's county seat Avabruck once stood
